title: My School and My Classroom
scene: 学校长什么样，教室里有什么

sentences.text: My school is new, and it is a high building.
sentences.gloss: 我的学校是新的，是一幢高楼。

sentences.text: We come in at the big gate, and the library is on the first floor.
sentences.gloss: 我们从大门进去，图书馆在第一层。

sentences.text: Our classroom is on the second floor, so we walk up the stairs.
sentences.gloss: 我们的教室在第二层，所以我们要走楼梯上去。

sentences.text: There are many desks in our classroom, and I sit between Ben and the window.
sentences.gloss: 我们教室里有许多课桌，我坐在本和窗户中间。

sentences.text: My place is in the front, and Ben sits at the back.
sentences.gloss: 我的位置在前面，本坐在后面。

sentences.text: There is a board in front of us, and the teacher writes on it.
sentences.gloss: 我们前面有一块黑板，老师在上面写字。

sentences.text: A clock and some pictures are on the wall, and the pictures have many colors.
sentences.gloss: 墙上有一个钟和一些图画，那些图画有很多颜色。

sentences.text: We have one computer, and the teacher can show us things on it.
sentences.gloss: 我们有一台电脑，老师可以用它给我们看东西。

sentences.text: Our classroom is bright, and I like this place.
sentences.gloss: 我们的教室很明亮，我喜欢这个地方。
